description: This file defines the OrderService interface, which declares methods related to order management, total calculation, invoice generation, and order retrieval within the sales management system.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: An interface providing order-related operations such as total calculation, invoice generation, order processing, and status management within the system.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a status history entry to an order.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total order summary from an OrderSummary, considering customer and store context.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total for a shopping cart considering the customer and store context.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Generates a PDF invoice for an order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all orders for a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists orders for a store based on specific criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new order or updates an existing one.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order with provided customer, shopping cart items, summary, payment, and store info.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order with an additional transaction detail.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if an order has downloadable files.
